SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT NVL(INTERFACE_ID,' ') as INTERFACE_ID FROM UCUBE.T02_KEP_PUM WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N'
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT INTERFACE_ID ,PUMCODE ,PUMLINE ,REQCODE ,REQLINE ,ITEMCODE ,KEPCODE ,ITEMNAME ,NORM ,MAT ,UNITTYPE ,PUMQTY ,PRICE ,UNITPRICE ,MAKER ,REQEMPID ,REQORG ,REQWAREHOUSE ,EMAIL ,PROCESS_CODE ,ERROR_MESSAGE ,INTERFACE_DATE ,DETAILSPEC ,REMARK ,IF_FLAG ,REQEMPNAME FROM UCUBE.T02_KEP_PUM WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' AND INTERFACE_ID = '$G_RS.INTERFACE_ID$'
UPDATE UCUBE.T02_KEP_PUM SET IF_FLAG = 'Y', IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' AND INTERFACE_ID = '$G_RS.INTERFACE_ID$'
UPDATE UCUBE.T02_KEP_PUM SET IF_FLAG = 'E', IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' AND INTERFACE_ID = '$G_RS.INTERFACE_ID$'
